filter_non_pdf: filter non-PDF documents by checking MIME types and URL path extensions
filter_non_truncated: filter truncated documents that are not PDFs by checking content_truncated metadata
filter_non_pdf_ending_with_pdf: filter documents to keep only those with PDF MIME types detected
index_adapter: adapt WARC crawl data into indexed document format with UUID, media metadata, and fetch info
MIME_TYPES: define a mapping of PDF MIME type strings for document type detection
